industry.why: Underweight, carried, on the special topic of 30-Oct-26 ('Why the Defence Industry de-rated from July to October 2026 while Theon's forecasts rose'), whose first dated test, Rheinmetall's print on 5-Nov-26, did not reach this pack, so the conversion question is open and untested; the Bundestag budget vote on 27-Nov-26 is the next. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: F now, F prior, the fourth reading at F; both sectors F. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only); ceasefire talks on Ukraine (headlines, 2 November) are the least-supported cause named last week and move shares for days. One live holding, Theon (3.46%, from 4.05%, Fitness 40.6, memo re-triaged 5-Nov-26), judged in components 4 and 5; no Pool name. Counter-case: estimates have not fallen and the premium compression may already be the exit multiple. Back to C if relative strength leaves F as approvals convert; to F on a signed settlement followed by defence fund outflows.

sector.why: Neutral, carried, on the special topic of 30-Oct-26 on the Defence de-rating: its condition ('to D if relative strength stays F with the electronics names joining the fall') is half testable: Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: F now, D prior, but no source read the electronics and optronics names this week, so the split that holds this row above the industry is neither confirmed nor broken. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). Theon (3.46%) sits here with Technical Momentum F and Thematic Fit/Momentum F; its review is about its own case (component 5). Counter-case: a fourth reading at F is the market's view of the whole industry. To D on the electronics names joining the fall, or a fifth F with Theon's re-test finding the group, not its leverage, behind its fall.

geography.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): the Swiss index is among those Goldman (19 Oct) names as rallying alongside non-AI and low-beta exposures, which is the rotation this row was set on; the Swiss National Bank was not re-read this week, so last week's 'not hiking' stands. Relative strength is not graded by country. Counter-case unchanged: the franc takes 2 to 3 points a year off a Swiss exporter's reported profit (Sonova memo), and five of the Swiss Pool names are semiconductor names inside an Underweight sector. Back to C if the SNB joins the hikers or the franc reverses.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
